stopping_rules.rule: Before any provider action, commit tooling, register this draft, canonically freeze it with its registration commit, commit the freeze, publish the dedicated exact tooling ref, and substitute the exact freeze.protocol_sha256 for the non-launchable token.
Authorize one RunPod allocation attempt and one combined command only; no separate build pod, binary-hash pilot, resume, replacement scientific row, or second allocation.

Within that pod, record exact source/toolchain/build/binary manifests, pass both shared go test ./... gates, then attempt 2 arms x 6 cases x (3 warmups + 20 measured rounds) = 276 invocations at exactly 100 operations and stop.
Attempt each fixed cell once; retain every failure and never extend, select, replace, or reorder rounds using observed values.
A complete fingerprint mismatch is terminal wrong_answer even when the runner deliberately exits nonzero after sealing rows and manifests; no allocation or timing statistic is interpreted.

invalidation_rules: No v8 build, test, fingerprint, allocation, timing, provider action, or performance row may predate registration and canonical freeze.

Any mismatch in protocol, dedicated public ref, tooling commit/tree/archive, production commit/tree/parent/blob/diff, common benchmark/test blobs, runner/binding/campaign/analyzer, Go archive, compiler, image, request/response, command, output, receipt, archive manifest, cleanup, or derived binary identities is a mechanical analysis failure; the study is inconclusive and emits no scientific verdict.
The production candidate commit changes coord.go and coord_test.go; the synthetic arms must overlay candidate coord_test.go identically and differ only at coord.go.

Provider cpu.memory must equal raw value 64 and cgroup memory.max exactly 64000000000; another flavor, CPU count, provider memory, cgroup limit, cloud, image, GPU, SSH path, or price above $1/hour invalidates the allocation.

A timeout, missing/duplicate/malformed row, wrong b.N, absent metric/artifact, nonfixed order, or failed correctness test is retained and mechanically inconclusive; it never licenses a retry or partial effect claim.
A complete cross-arm fingerprint mismatch is wrong_answer and rejects every performance claim before ratios are computed.

Any row or session steal delta, nr_throttled delta, memory.events delta/inventory change, affinity/CPU/topology/cpuset/placement change, missing/malformed PSI, CPU some avg10 > 10, nonzero CPU full avg10, or nonzero memory some/full avg10 invalidates both clocks; exact fields and valid allocation counts remain reportable.
Profiled, perf-instrumented, race-instrumented, resumed, restored, or nonregistered invocations are excluded from the decisive distribution.
V7 rows, post-hoc bounds, executable sizes, build duration, and any future diagnostic perf/profile run are not v8 data.

decision_rule.text: Mechanical completeness and identity are mandatory. Next require all 120 measured fingerprint pairs to match exactly. Allocation passes only when both paired-median candidate/baseline B/op and allocs/op are <=1/20 in every case. Timing passes only when every numeric isolation gate passes and, in all twelve case-clock cells, the observed paired median baseline/candidate is >=21/20 and the exact empirical bootstrap-median q=1/480 lower bound is >1. Exact bootstrap enumeration uses rational arithmetic and no RNG. Terminal precedence: incomplete/identity failure is analysis failure/inconclusive; mismatch wrong_answer; invalid clocks plus allocation pass allocation_only, otherwise invalid_measurement; valid clocks with both gates supported_within_scope, allocation alone allocation_only, timing alone timing_only, neither unsupported.
decision_rule.threshold: exact fingerprints equal; both allocation medians <=1/20 in all six cases; valid numeric isolation; all wall/CPU medians >=21/20 and q=1/480 lower bounds >1
decision_rule.statistic: Within each case and replicate, candidate/baseline ratios for allocations and baseline/candidate ratios for clocks; observed statistic is the exact median of 20 pair ratios (average of sorted positions 10 and 11).
decision_rule.interval: For each clock cell, enumerate all 20^20 resamples with replacement through exact joint order-statistic masses for bootstrap positions 10 and 11; exact rational q=1/480 lower quantile is inf{x:CDF(x)>=1/480}; no RNG, interpolation, Monte Carlo, or asymptotic approximation.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: paired median allocation ratio and paired median wall/CPU speedup per case
